not_confirmed.title: E no confirm

explain.heading: Why this one fit be fake
explain.fallback: We no see this message for your bank records. Fraudsters dey copy bank style make people click link, call number or share code. Treat am as fake unless your bank app confirm am.

explain.aiNote: Na computer write this explanation by imself, and e no fit change the result wey dey up.

intro.title:
Na your bank
for real?
intro.body: Check messages and calls against your bank own records before you click, call or reply.

message.title:
Paste am.
Share am. Know.
message.body: Share SMS, WhatsApp message or link give Gaskiyya. Your bank go either confirm say e send am give you, or e no send am, or Gaskiyya go tell you say e no fit check am now.

call.title:
Code wey only your
bank fit read
call.body: When your bank call you, the app go show four-digit code. Real agent go read the same code give you.

privacy.title:
Your messages
na your own
privacy.body: Na for your phone we dey fingerprint message text. Na only the fingerprint dey decide the result, never the words. To explain result wey no confirm, we go send the text one time with long numbers hidden.

link.title: Link your bank
link.intro: Gaskiyya dey check messages wey dem send to your number. Inside your bank app, e dey happen by imself when you sign in.
link.enterNumber: Put your Nigerian mobile number, like 0801 234 5678.
link.cannotReachBank: We no fit reach your bank. Check your connection and try again.
link.banksUnreachable: We no fit reach Gaskiyya to list the banks.
link.noBanks: No bank dey on Gaskiyya yet. Tell your bank make dem join.

check.fingerprintNote: Na for this phone we dey fingerprint the message. Na only the fingerprint we dey send to check the message. If e no confirm, we go send the text, with long numbers hidden, to explain why.
check.inboxEmpty: Messages wey your bank send to this number go show here. You fit also share any message give Gaskiyya from another app.

result.checking: We dey check with your bank…
result.rateLimited: You don check too many times. Try again after one minute.
result.screenshotText: Text wey we read from the screenshot

calls.howItWorks: When your bank call you, notice and four-digit code go show here sharp sharp. People fit fake caller ID; dem no fit fake this code.

activity.footer: We build this from wetin your bank register: type, channel and whether link dey inside. Never the message text.

settings.textStays: We no dey store message text. To explain result, we go send the text one time with long numbers hidden.
settings.numbersMasked: We dey always hide long numbers
settings.reportsConsent: We dey report only when you agree
settings.unlinkBody: You fit link am again any time.
